chat.welcome.title: 🤖 Welcome to Local AI Assistant!
chat.welcome.subtitle: Select an existing chat or create a new one
chat.actions.title: Actions performed
settings.voice.sttHint: Whisper model. Missing models are downloaded on first use. Requires restart.
settings.voice.sttCustom: Another model: owner/repo or a folder path
settings.hotkeys.hint: Format: Ctrl+Shift+V, Alt+F9, F12, Ctrl+Num0. Applied after restarting the app.
persona.hint: A persona is a behaviour layer on top of the system prompt. If none is selected, the standard system prompt is used. Switching is instant, no restart needed.
persona.empty: No personas yet. Click "Add persona" to create one.
persona.form.name: Name
settings.personality.layer: Extra instructions (appended to the system prompt)
settings.personality.hint: Service rules (search, tools, language) stay system-managed and are not editable — here you set the assistant's style and character only.
settings.personality.placeholder: e.g. Be concise, use bullet points, no slang
memory.title: Memory (ChromaDB)
memory.empty: Memory is empty. Assistant hasn't saved important facts yet.
status.title: System Status
settings.title: Settings
settings.language.hint: Interface language. Default is English on first launch.
settings.showConsole.hint: If disabled (default), backend runs hidden and logs appear in the in-app Terminal.
settings.context.hint.lmstudio: ⚠️ For LM Studio configure model and context in LM Studio itself (reload model there) and restart the app.
settings.context.hint.ollama: ℹ️ For Ollama it will apply immediately.
settings.memory.results.hint: How many memory entries to add to context. Each ≈150 tokens. 3 × ≈450 tokens
settings.memory.threshold.hint: RAG relevance filter. 0.0 — finds everything (noise), 0.3 — balanced, 0.6+ — only exact matches (often empty). If "not found in memory" — lower to 0.2
settings.saved: Settings saved! Restart the app to apply.
alert.voiceNotSupported: Voice input is not supported in this browser
alert.ttsLoadFailed: Failed to load OmniVoice model. Check backend logs
voice.tooShort: Recording is too short or empty — hold the button and speak
persona.editor.hint: Save the persona with the button at the bottom of the window - there are no separate buttons here.
prompt.langHint: Only the block matching the interface language (Settings → General) is applied. You do not need to fill in both — the other one is inactive.
settings.personality.placeholder.ru: Например: Отвечай кратко, используй списки, без сленга
settings.personality.placeholder.en: e.g. Be concise, use bullet points, no slang
settings.wake.privacy: While enabled the app keeps the microphone open and listens continuously. Nothing is recorded to disk - audio is recognised on the fly and discarded.
settings.wake.phraseHint: Any phrase you can say, for example just the assistant name. Case and punctuation do not matter.
settings.wake.modelHint: Uses its own small model; the regular Whisper used for commands is untouched.
settings.wake.deviceHint: The device that listens continuously. Regular voice input and the wake word can use different microphones.
settings.wake.listeningOn: Microphone "{device}" is listening for the phrase "{phrase}"
settings.wake.levelIdle: The bar is not moving - the microphone hears nothing.
settings.wake.levelOk: The microphone hears sound. If the phrase still fails, try the base model.
